addressedFindings.change: Process selection, stdin text and revision now share one state. Every explicit selection and text edit advances the revision. The send kind explicitly distinguishes text from interrupt and close controls. Only an accepted text call may clear the exact submitted processHandle and revision. Control-only success leaves input intact. Existing workflow receipt, unknown-outcome and no-replay behavior remain in use.
regressionCoverage: selection away and back with same text
unknown followed by original accepted receipt retains draft and does not replay

fixPhaseDiscoveries.trigger: A delayed process/spawn response arrives after the user selected another process or edited stdin; even an unchanged pre-existing draft was carried into the spawned process. A delayed removal of exited process A arrives after the user selected running process B and typed a draft.
fixPhaseDiscoveries.impact: Spawn success silently rebinds an unsent draft to another process. Removal success clears the later selected process and hides or discards its draft.
fixPhaseDiscoveries.evidence: Three delayed-spawn component tests failed against the original source in run-96kgbl. The delayed-removal component test failed before its guard in run-qyC5zv. All four pass in the final run.
fixPhaseDiscoveries.change: Successful spawn auto-selects only when the captured owner/revision is still current and no unsent input exists. Otherwise it refreshes the process list and visibly explains that the process started but the current selection/input was retained. Successful removal clears selection only when its captured owner/revision remains current.
fixPhaseDiscoveries.auditRecordHandling: Discovered and recorded during the authorized repair phase; no old round7 audit evidence or coverage was modified.

implementationReview: Re-read the final component. All asynchronous writers of process selection are covered: explicit selection/disconnect changes revision; spawn and removal check their captured owner/revision; accepted stdin checks the submitted owner/revision and intent kind. Epoch/connection replacement still remounts the process session, and useWorkflow still suppresses results after unmount. No mutation or receipt API was changed.

validation.method: Test-first React/jsdom interactions using real Api/useWorkflow/local operation storage with an isolated fetch fixture and deferred response promises. These are component regressions, not source-extraction VM checks.
